runtimeArgs: const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const root=process.cwd();const types={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8'};http.createServer((q,s)=>{let p=decodeURIComponent(q.url.split('?')[0]);if(p==='/')p='/index.html';const f=path.join(root,p);fs.readFile(f,(e,d)=>{if(e){s.writeHead(404);s.end('404');return;}s.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':types[path.extname(f)]||'application/octet-stream','Cache-Control':'no-store'});s.end(d);});}).listen(5510,()=>console.log('dev server on http://localhost:5510'));
